name: He
source:
Protagonist of Route D, a robust man.

The lone hacker of urban legends. His name and origin are unknown. Not leaving any traces has lead many to question his very existence.
[spoiler]Seeks vengeance for the death of his loved one, "He" desperately continues fighting against "that organization".[/spoiler]
[spoiler]He is voiced by Hagi Michihiko.[/spoiler]
